Key findings for the map: (1) the 2015 Ferrario long take (00:49-01:58) starts at the salotto door, passes the coat passage/vestibule with the GOSH! pasta picture, runs the whole corridor A (prints on the left wall), turns at a barred glazed balcony door with a radiator, enters the study by the stepladder, walks between the islands to the desk row under the windows, stops at a white door with three light switches and a pinned note to take a book, and walks back along the desk row; the granddaughter skates the same route in reverse at 01:14:52-01:15:12. (2) Shelf edges carry the Fondazione lettering physically: 'A' labels in the corridor (44:04, 44:34), L4.10/L4.11 (13:07), L11.5-L12.8 (35:19, 45:14), Q4/Q5 (09:26); a low unit is labelled 'Libri e riviste ricevuti dopo il 2016'.
